title: compose says to cd into the worktree, work says never cd; warden done then needs a task id
body: What happened: compose step 7 says to cd into the worktree and run every later command from there. The work skill says never to run cd <dir> && ..., so a session that follows the work rule stays in the main checkout. There, 'warden done --json ...' fails with: warden: no active run in this worktree; live runs: PG-305 (plan); pass the task id: warden done <task>. Expected: the two skills agree, for example compose says to pass the task id (warden done PG-305) or to use absolute paths instead of cd. Steps: run /warden:compose with --worktree from the main checkout, then follow the work skill and call warden done without a task id. Evidence: the error message above.
note: Fixed. A plain cd on its own is fine; never chain it with &&.
